— Our Story

A little caprice, every single day.

El Capricho means the whim — and that is exactly how we want you to feel here. Come in for a morning cortado, stay for a long lunch, and let the evening slide by over something cold and sparkling.

Beans roasted in small batches, plates made from scratch, and a room built for lingering. No rush. Just good company.
